say: So when do you move to n8n or Power Automate? When the start is an event. When one flow touches three or more systems. When it runs all day, or the output must be identical. When many people depend on it, so IT must own it. When you need a formal approval with a record. And often the best answer is both: n8n or Power Automate carries the data between systems, and Claude is one step inside the flow that reads and writes.
